faq_heading: New construction in Burke Mountain: your questions answered

faq.q: What have townhomes in Burke Mountain sold for?
faq.a: 149 townhomes sold in Burke Mountain at a median of $1,100,000, with the middle half between $955,000 and $1,298,000.

faq.q: How long do homes take to sell in Burke Mountain?
faq.a: In Burke Mountain, townhomes were quickest at 14 days at a median, and houses slowest at 25 days.

faq.q: Which homes in Burke Mountain are the newest?
faq.a: Of the homes that resold in Burke Mountain, townhomes had the newest median build year, 2023.

blocks.text: This search shows active Burke Mountain listings that the MLS® records with an age of 0 or less: homes completed this year and homes listed before completion, across houses, townhomes and condos. Over November 2025 to October 2026, the busiest home type in Burke Mountain was townhomes: 149 sales at a median of $1,100,000, and 2 types had 5 or more sales.

items.t: In Burke Mountain, houses sold at a median of $1,954,000 across 58 sales, and the middle half closed between $1,770,625 and $2,158,750. The median house sat 25 days and sold for 96.3% of list.
Burke Mountain: 149 townhomes sold at a median of $1,100,000, with the middle half between $955,000 and $1,298,000. The median townhome took 14 days to sell and closed at 99.5% of list.

blocks.text: Source: Paragon closed sales, November 1, 2025 to October 22, 2026; medians need 5 or more sales.
How Burke Mountain compares with the rest of Coquitlam

items.t: Of 20 Coquitlam sub-areas with 5 or more house sales, Burke Mountain ranks second highest at $1,954,000; the range is $984,000 (Meadow Brook) to $2,000,000 (Harbour Place). Maillardville ($1,890,000) sits just below and Harbour Place ($2,000,000) sits just above.

Townhomes in Burke Mountain have the second highest median of 11 Coquitlam sub-areas, $1,100,000. Central Coquitlam is lowest at $617,500 and Westwood Plateau highest at $1,132,500. New Horizons ($1,055,000) sits just below and Westwood Plateau ($1,132,500) sits just above.

blocks.text: By build year, townhomes are the newest homes selling in Burke Mountain (median 2023) and houses the oldest (median 2014), a gap of 9 years.
